_doc: Fixed sprite light rig (06_STYLE_ART.md section 3). Lights are placed relative to the camera, so every facing is lit the same way and the character turns under them. Directions: azimuth_deg is measured from the camera's view axis seen from above, positive towards camera-left; 0 = light shining from behind the camera onto the character's camera-facing side, 180 = from behind the character. elevation_deg is above the horizon. All lights are suns with cast shadows off: shadows are a separate blob sprite in-engine. Energies are sun strength in W/m2. The rim light is a DRAFT addition: 06 section 3 lists one key and one fill only; keep or drop is a director decision from the sample sheet.
engine_doc: EEVEE, one render sample (no anti-aliasing at the 4x stage), transparent film, Standard view transform so colours are not tone-mapped
